quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Highest role quality inside the Intelligence-qualified pool. Price does not affect selection.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balances role quality (75%) and affordability (25%). Excludes the highest task-price level, including ties, before recalculating the mean + 2 standard-deviation cutoff.

budget.label: Budget
budget.description: Maximizes 40% role quality and 60% affordability. Excludes the two highest distinct task-price levels, including all ties, before recalculating the mean + 2 standard-deviation cutoff.

swapEvaluation.note: Lineups are generated from current benchmark data; weekly review compares regenerated portfolios rather than static single-seat picks.

planEconomics.note: Max 10x and Max 20x have identical price-to-allowance ratios; portfolio ordering is invariant between them.

premiumPlacement.description: Prefer expensive models in planning/review and cheaper models in execution. Balanced may trade up to 1% of total Balanced objective for better placement; Quality and Budget use placement only as an exact-objective tie-break.
